title: Additional direct-import literature audit for anisotropic and unbounded quantum phase theorems

finding: The four inspected sources narrow plausible direct-import routes but none supplies an inspectable theorem importable unchanged into untruncated Q3LOCK. Exact anisotropic continuous-oscillator coverage and novelty remain open to signed specialist review.
decision_reason: The source/model interfaces remove four plausible invalid shortcuts, but the search is bounded and not exhaustive. The conservative verdict is inconclusive rather than a novelty or non-applicability certificate.
boundary: T0 literature applicability audit; comparison-only; no theorem promotion, claim-tier change, priority statement, or PDF status change.
